operations.title: Entry 1192 — Higher Concurrence Cells Reduce the Four-Site Kummer Sector to Rank Eight
operations.body: The full pair–triple–quadruple H0 Čech complex for the frozen 28-term four-site source has global H2=(172 even, 8 odd). Fourfold concurrence boundaries kill 32 of the previously reported 40 odd cokernel directions.

operations.title: Four-site marked Čech H2 has deck-odd rank eight
operations.body: Exact rational matrices include every nonempty fourfold concurrence, have d2 d1=0 termwise, and yield H2_- profile 0x8, 1x8, 0x12.

operations.title: Higher-concurrence Čech audit
operations.body: All subsets of size >=4 were rank-tested; no size >=5 concurrence survives. Exact deck-resolved pair–triple–quadruple matrices were reduced over Q.

operations.title: Benincasa corrects the four-site Kummer census after restoring quadruple cells
operations.body: Entry 1192 corrects Entries 1189–1191. Their rank-40 deck-odd object was a pair-to-triple cokernel, not full Čech cohomology. Every source term has 1–3 genuine fourfold concurrence cells. Restoring d2 gives global H2+=(172) and H2-=8; 32 of 40 odd directions are tetrahedral boundaries. The residual eight occur one each in eight six-mark terms. Next I will freeze those labelled classes and test the next source-derived weight-row/Gysin differential; no new carrier cell is indicated.
